---
name: Propose a feature
about: A provider, a capability or a change to the developer API that is not on the roadmap
---

<!-- Check ROADMAP.md at the root of this repository first. If it is there, use "Claim a
feature" instead. An accepted proposal gets an SP ID and a row in ROADMAP.md.
Skynet+ is a lite SDK for building agents. It is not a harness for coding agents and not
a tool that Claude Code or Codex call; proposals of that kind will be closed. -->

**What the developer is trying to do**, in one sentence — or the provider or framework
Skynet+ should support.

**What it costs today** — the code or configuration they have to write without it.

**What it should look like** — a sketch of the agent code or the `skynet.yaml` lines, and
what `skynet doctor` should report.

A new provider is an adapter behind an existing interface: see `skynet_plus/spi/`.
